name: Builder feedback campaign
audience: Vibe coders, AI and Claude developers sharing actual apps, development workflows and requests for feedback
approach: Review a real demo, public page or README; give a specific observation and one useful suggestion or question. Use product links only when they directly answer the discussion.
continuation: Start each future session with responses to these conversations. Review a few fresh builder projects, then engage only when there is useful original feedback.
automationStatus: Foreground timer emits due events in the active session; agent reviews and executes through T3 preview. No independent browser worker or persistent schedule.

runInstructions: Read this ledger and review incoming responses first; continue useful existing conversations before finding new ones
Find AI and Claude developers sharing concrete apps, code, demos or requests for help; read the full post and visible thread
Inspect the relevant public screen, clip or source when needed for specific feedback; do not claim testing or installation that did not happen
Start lowercase, use natural concise language, no final period and no em dash; no copied templates or invented personal experience
At most one new conversation per check; skip when there is no useful original feedback. Do not repeat cold replies to the same person within seven days
Like a relevant original contribution when appropriate; avoid unsolicited promotional links
Verify exact draft and target before one submit; verify published text and URL, plus Unlike after a like. Inspect uncertain outcomes before retrying
Record receipts before the next check; do not count outbound activity as reach, responses or adoption
Use the product-native collaborative browser. Stop if authentication expires, publishing is restricted, or no supported browser is available
